resolved.title: Python 数据结构
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Python Data Structures[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Almost every program uses [b]data[/b]. 
Organizing, managing and storing data is important as it enables easier access and efficient modifications. 

[b]Data Structures[/b] allow you to store and manage your data. 

Python has a number of [b]built-in[/b] data structures:
 - [b]Strings[/b]
 - [b]Lists[/b]
 - [b]Dictionaries[/b]
 - [b]Tuples[/b]
 - [b]Sets[/b]

During this course, we will learn about these data structures, use them to store data and see their real-life applications. 
[note]If you are not familiar with the basics of Python, please complete our [b]Python for Beginners[/b] course first.[/note]

content.text:
几乎所有的程序都需要使用**数据结构**。组织、管理和存储数据是很重要的，**数据结构**让我们在写程序的时候，更容易存储和管理数据。

Python 有许多内建的数据结构：
 - **字符串**
 - **列表**
 - **字典**
 - **元组**
 - **集合**

在本课程中，我们将了解这些数据结构，用它们来存储数据，实现需求。

  • Dictionaries
  • Tuples
  • Sets

During this course, we will learn about these data structures, use them to store data and see their real-life applications.

resolved.title: Python数据结构
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Python Data Structures[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In addition to the built-in data structures, Python allows you to create your own data structures, enabling you to have full control over their functionality. 

The most prominent data structures are:
 - [b]Stacks[/b]
 - [b]Queues[/b]
 - [b]Trees[/b]
 - [b]Linked Lists[/b]

[note]These data structures have many uses in popular algorithms. We will learn about them in the coming modules.[/note]

content.text:
除了内置的数据结构，Python允许你创建自己的数据结构，使你能够完全控制更复杂的功能。

常见的几种用户定义结构：
 - **堆栈**
 - **队列**
 - **树**
 - **单链表**
 - **图**
content.text_html:
In addition to the built-in data structures, Python allows you to create your own data structures, enabling you to have full control over their functionality.

The most prominent data structures are:

  • Stacks
  • Queues
  • Trees
  • Linked Lists

除了内置的数据结构，Python 允许你创建自己的数据结构，使你能够完全控制其功能。

最突出的数据结构是。

  • 堆栈
  • 队列
  • 树
  • 链接的列表
